summary.name: Remove BG
summary.one_liner: Remove Bg is a browser-based AI background remover that cuts out the main subject of a JPG, PNG, or WebP image and lets you download a transparent PNG.
use_cases: Create transparent product images for online stores and marketplaces
Isolate houses and furniture for property listings
Cut out portraits, groups, and pets from photos
Make logos transparent for print or presentations
Prepare images for ads and catalogs
summary.what_it_does: The tool automatically identifies the main subject in an uploaded image and removes the surrounding background. Users can upload JPG, PNG, or WebP files, paste an image URL, or drag a photo into the upload area, with up to 5 images at once and a 20 MB limit per file. A before-and-after slider lets users compare the original with the transparent result. Users can refine edges with Erase or Restore tools before downloading a transparent PNG. The page says processing happens directly in the browser without software installation.
notable: Automatic subject separation that aims to keep hair, fur, and soft shadows natural
Erase and Restore tools for quick edge finishing
Batch upload of up to 5 images at once
Runs in the browser with no installation
caveats: Page describes a free trial and a credit-based plan for background removal, so full use may require credits
Upload limit of 20 MB per image and JPG, PNG, WebP, or ZIP formats
